note: Tao and Deng discuss how mathematics should respond as AI produces proofs at scale: preserving understanding, tracing credit for ideas, and rewarding explanation and community building as well as problem-solving. They make the case for open science and introduce SAIR's Open Math OS.
title: Terence Tao & Yu Deng: Why We Build Open Math Model
who: Terence Tao (UCLA) and Yu Deng (University of Chicago), SAIR Foundation
